name: Banked Embers
description: Gather Ember Cores to keep Ironhaven's furnaces burning.

dialogue.offer: Ironhaven's deep furnaces need six Ember Cores. The imps below Cavern carry the hottest ones.
dialogue.in_progress: Six cores will keep every forge in town burning through the night.
dialogue.ready: I can feel their heat from here. The smiths will put them to good use.
dialogue.completed: The furnaces have not burned this cleanly in years.
